description: USA Storm Reports is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This map contains continuously updated U.S. tornado reports, wind storm reports and hail storm reports. Click each feature to receive information about the specific location and read a short description about the issue. Now contains ALL available Incident Report types, for a total of 15, not just Hail; Wind; and Tornados. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Weather. Its keywords are severe weather, weather forecasting. The portal shows 2024-04-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ESRI Custom License (https://content.esri.com/arcgisonline/docs/tou_summary.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
